RemediationStrings.Title: Device missing critical updates
RemediationStrings.Description: Critical drivers, firmware, or BIOS updates are missing on this device. Please run Dell SupportAssist to install the required updates to maintain system security and performance.

RemediationStrings.Title: Updates require restart
RemediationStrings.Description: One or more updates require a restart to complete. Please restart your device to apply the updates. If you have to resync your device by Microsoft Company Portal to check compliance again.

RemediationStrings.Title: SupportAssist Version supported
RemediationStrings.Description: Checking Company Portal for SupportAssist version 5.2 or later and install this version

RemediationStrings.Title: Diagnose create Error
RemediationStrings.Description: Contact your Administrator to check this problem
